## Prior hyperparameter calibration

### Prior distributions

::: {#fig-prior-distributions}

![](./figures/prior_calibration/01_comprehensive_prior_distributions.png){width=70%}

Prior distributions for the dimensionless piecewise activation model
:::

### Dynamic patterns generated by prior samples

::: {#fig-pattern-time-courses}

![](./figures/prior_calibration/02_pattern_time_courses_seed_42.png){width=70%}

Pattern time courses and $(u, s)$-phase portraits for randomly sampled model parameters
:::

### Parameter space phase diagrams

::: {#fig-phase-diagrams}

![](./figures/prior_calibration/03_phase_diagrams.png){width=70%}

Phase diagrams showing parameter relationships across the three activation patterns: pre-activation (red), transient (blue), and sustained (green)
:::



### Pattern-specific parameter distributions

::: {#fig-enhanced-prior-distributions}

![](./figures/prior_calibration/05_enhanced_prior_distributions.png){width=70%}

Parameter distributions broken down by activation pattern, showing how fold-change, onset time, duration, and other parameters vary across pre-activation, transient, and sustained patterns
:::

### Activation pattern coverage

::: {#fig-pattern-coverage}

![](./figures/prior_calibration/06_pattern_coverage.png){width=70%}

Distribution of genes across the three activation patterns generated by the prior, showing balanced coverage with 23% pre-activation, 58.8% transient, and 18.2% sustained patterns
:::
